workbook.name: EV_Charging_Site_Readiness_M2_Canonical
workbook.description: Future City Fellowship - EV charging site readiness. Every value derives from the canonical data contract v1.0.0 in mode milestone2_v3. CAPACITY IS A PLACEHOLDER AT ALL 12 SITES - not evidence of electrical feasibility. Screening study; nothing approved or funded.

worksheets.name: Readiness by Site
worksheets.title: Site readiness ranking — canonical milestone2_v3
worksheets.subtitle: All 12 sites are LOW data confidence; the colour legend has one value on purpose.

worksheets.name: Starter vs Pathway Ports
worksheets.title: Starter ports today vs pathway capacity to leave room for
worksheets.subtitle: Portfolio: 25 starter, 48 pathway. NOT additive - pathway is the ceiling. Grouped bars, not bar-in-bar - see CAPABILITY_GAP.md.

worksheets.name: Ports Across Horizons
worksheets.title: Active ports by planning horizon
worksheets.subtitle: 48-port pathway ceiling is in the tooltip — no reference line, see CAPABILITY_GAP.md.

worksheets.name: Lifecycle Cost by Horizon
worksheets.title: Lifecycle cost, net present value (base escalation)
worksheets.subtitle: Screening-class estimates for comparison only. Never a budget, quote or bid.

worksheets.name: Net CO2e by Horizon
worksheets.title: Net CO2e, tonnes per year
worksheets.subtitle: 596.3 lb CO2e/MWh, eGRID2023r2, accessed 2026-07-19, SRVC. Demand is modelled, not measured.

worksheets.name: Peak Waits by Site
worksheets.title: Queue wait, minutes - mean simulated and peak-window Erlang
worksheets.subtitle: p50 and p90 are 0.0 at ALL 12 sites: utilisation is 6-20%, so a typical day has no queue. 10-minute screening threshold; no reference line generated.

worksheets.name: Site Map
worksheets.title: Candidate sites, Northern Virginia
worksheets.subtitle: Symbol map, not a choropleth. Mark size is pathway capacity; every capacity_basis is 'placeholder'.
